title: Things related to Samba are listed without a name under Places > History > Folders
line: Kickoff's History now shows a name for Samba locations like the network root or a server, instead of a blank entry.
explanation: Kickoff's History labels a recent folder with its Places name or, failing that, its file name. URLs like smb:/ or smb://server/ have no file name, so those entries showed only an icon. The change falls back to the host name, or to the URL itself, the same texts Dolphin uses for its tab titles.

commits.message:
kicker: Show a name for recent folders without a file name

Kickoff's History listed folders like smb:/ or smb://server/ without a
label, because their URL has no file name to show. Fall back to the
host name, or to the URL itself, as Dolphin does for its tab titles.

BUG: 516894

media.caption: Folders: smb:/ and smb://server/ show as two entries with no label
The same entries now read "smb:/" and "server"

review.text: Clean and minimal fix in the right place (RecentUsageModel::docData). When a URL has no Places match and no filename (such as smb:/ or smb://server/), falling back to url.host() and then url.toDisplayString(QUrl::PreferLocalFile) matches Dolphin's tab title behavior and avoids leaking passwords. The before/after screenshots clearly verify the fix without affecting regular local folders or Places entries.

reviews.text: Clean and minimal fix in the right place (RecentUsageModel::docData). When a URL has no Places match and no filename (such as smb:/ or smb://server/), falling back to url.host() and then url.toDisplayString(QUrl::PreferLocalFile) matches Dolphin's tab title behavior and avoids leaking passwords. The before/after screenshots clearly verify the fix without affecting regular local folders or Places entries.

Right place and right cause: RecentUsageModel::docData() returns KFileItem::text(), which is empty for smb:/ and smb://server/, and the before/after shots show those two entries getting labels. But the fallback goes straight to url.host(), so any folder URL recorded with a trailing slash (smb://server/share/, sftp://host/dir/) is labelled with just the server name, giving several identical, wrong 'server' entries; the notes admit this. The commit message says it matches Dolphin's tab titles, but DolphinViewContainer::caption() strips the trailing slash and tries the file name, then the path, before it falls back to the host.
changes: Before using the host, fall back to url.adjusted(QUrl::StripTrailingSlash).fileName() (and then the path), as DolphinViewContainer::caption() does, so smb://server/share/ shows 'share' and not 'server'.
Verify with a trailing-slash share URL as well as smb:/ and smb://server/, and fix the commit message so its comparison with Dolphin is accurate.
